narrative: Adjust read_ttf_csv so missing TTF files are generated from local PDS/CDS without attempting network refresh. Enables offline workflow when creating MLF patterns.
user_input: for i in  EUR/USD AUD/CAD AUD/USD USD/CAD GBP/USD XAU/USD;do for t in D1;do mlfcli -i $i -t $t -pn $pattern -uf -old;done;done
